correctness.rationale: The first 14 distinct admissible reciprocals give at most 243508/245025 < 1. If a 15-term solution omits any of the first 13 denominators, its largest possible sum is attained by dropping 99 from the 15 largest reciprocals and adding 1/135; the resulting 1224041/1225125 is below 1. The forced first 13 terms leave 322/22275. With x<y, 1/x+1/y<2/x forces x<22275/161<139. An independent exact exponent sieve through 138 (not just the bundled script's 135) gives only 121, 125, 135 greater than 99; exact substitution gives 245025/1517, 111375/719, 22275/157 for y, none integral. The size bound is on x only and excludes arbitrarily large y by solving its equation, so no denominator cap is presumed. Multiplying by the odd common denominator forces odd length and excludes 16. Independent rational addition verifies the distinct 17-denominator witness sums to 1, and factorization verifies its support. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
